q.en: The 'Ain-i-Akbari' primarily deals with which subject?

options.en: Administration and statistics of Akbar's empire

explanation.en: The Ain-i-Akbari is the third volume of the Akbarnama, describing the administration, revenue and statistics of the empire.
explanation.as: আইন-ই-আকবৰী আকবৰনামাৰ তৃতীয় খণ্ড, যি সাম্ৰাজ্যৰ প্ৰশাসন, ৰাজহ আৰু পৰিসংখ্যা বৰ্ণনা কৰে।
